decisions.reason: This small-volume ionization chamber remains close to the firm's core dosimetry business, and if it has stayed available this long its option value and low carrying cost still outweigh reasons to withdraw.
Although overlap with other chamber models raises some pruning risk, it is still a modest-cost option in a core measurement category and does not yet justify abandonment.
A standard clinical ionization chamber line with several models serves routine customer needs, anchors the core portfolio, and is therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

This relative-dosimetry chamber is more specialized than the standard line but still complements the firm's integrated QA offering, so management would likely keep it unless demand clearly disappoints.
